name: power-view
description: Power View: the Progress Only style with a live steps box and hidden tool calls, plus the Tools tray for model, effort, styles and helper agents, an Agents pane for subagents and chats with other agent CLIs, a Team pane to chat with your dev team of custom subagents one by one or all at once, a files pane with an editor, and a Sessions pane to start, switch and resume sessions
